skill.name: three-component
skill.description: Create a React Three Fiber 3D component for the Kardashev Network visualization

generated_query: I'm building a real-time dashboard to visualize solar energy production from a network of solar panels. I need a 3D component that shows a glowing sun whose intensity, size, and particle effects change based on live irradiance data (GHI in W/m²). The sun should also have a subtle rotation animation and a bloom post-processing effect to make it look realistic. The component should accept props for `ghi`, `cloudCover`, and `isDay` to drive the visuals, and it needs to be performant on both desktop and mobile. Can you help me create this React Three Fiber component?
